title: Proposed Amendments to City of Silverton Municipal Charter
ballot_label: Proposed Amendments to City of Silverton Municipal Charter. Question: Shall the legal voters of the City of Silverton approve the proposed amendments to the municipal charter?
summary: Asks Silverton voters to amend the city charter, last amended in 1985. According to the ballot summary, the amendments would remove or amend sections that may not comply with or unnecessarily duplicate state law, clarify certain City Council rights, duties and procedures, and clarify certain city manager responsibilities. The explanatory statement says some sections would be repealed, others added, and the Mayor section folded into another section. Amendments would take effect January 1, 2027.
yes_means: A yes vote approves the proposed amendments to the City of Silverton charter, effective January 1, 2027.
no_means: A no vote rejects the proposed amendments, leaving the current Silverton charter (last amended in 1985) unchanged.
